description: This Java source file defines the main activity for an Android application, managing fragment transactions and implementing a CardStream interface to handle a card-based UI structure. It sets up and restores fragment states, enforces interface implementations, and coordinates interactions between UI fragments.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity class manages the core UI fragments of the app, setting up the card stream, handling fragment state restoration, and ensuring interface contracts are fulfilled.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up fragments, and establishes click listeners.

methods.name: getCardStream
methods.description: Returns the current CardStreamFragment instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current state of the card stream into a retention fragment for state persistence.
